en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph showing a sanatorium or large residential building with multiple stories, surrounded by smaller houses and fields. Rolling hills or mountains are visible in the background, under a partly cloudy sky. The foreground includes a garden or field area with trees and scattered fencing. Handwritten script is visible across the sky portion of the image. At the bottom, formal printed text reads: 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Kuranstalt Dr. Buchinger Wiesenhaus.' The reverse side features a handwritten message in German, an address, and a blue stamp/mark from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
